title: Regime-Locked Measurement as a General Structural Constraint
subtitle: Cross-Domain Framework, Operational Meta-Regime Protocol, and Quantitative Regime-Appropriateness Scoring
author: Morten Magnusson
abstract: Formalises regime-locked measurement as a general structural constraint. Shared structural pattern across six domains. Three contributions: alpha-score alpha(phi, R) in [0,1], blind-set taxonomy (ontological/methodological/instrumental), and five-step meta-regime protocol. Worked example identifies convergence drift in AI alignment.

epistemic_status.content: Regime, regime-locked measurement, CDVC, meta-regime, alpha-score, blind-set taxonomy
Shared pattern across domains; meta-regime detects blind spots; alpha outperforms binary
S0/S1 observational equivalence at gradient extremes

regime.B: Blind set (typically invisible from within R)
regime.key_property: Absence of signal is indistinguishable from absence of phenomenon

regime_locked_measurement.definition: m in V(R_i) and m not in V(R_j) for i != j
regime_locked_measurement.meaning: Phenomena in B(R_i) are not merely unmeasured — they are unmeasurable within R_i

cdvc.definition: sigma in intersection V(R_k) for N >= 3 domains

residual_inference.procedure: r = data - model(I); test for clustering, scale-dependence, correlation

s0_s1_conjecture.description: At gradient extremes, different generative processes produce indistinguishable outputs
s0_s1_conjecture.ai_formulation: Deep framework integration (S0) vs superficial linguistic mirroring (S1)
s0_s1_conjecture.connection: Identifiability problem in inverse problems / latent-variable models

domains.residual_signal: Pre-9/11 cross-agency signals in each B
2008 crisis: low-volatility calibration blind at boundary

protocol.name: Meta-Regime Evaluation Protocol (Algorithm 1)
protocol.input: Instrument I, target phenomenon phi, candidate regimes {R_1,...,R_n}

steps.name: Cross-Regime Check
steps.action: For each b in B_i, test if b in V_j for some j != i

steps.name: Residual Analysis
steps.action: Test residuals for structure -> B_inferred candidates

steps.name: Alpha-Scoring
steps.action: Estimate alpha; flag if below threshold; report B types

worked_example.step1: Current instruments in deviation-detection regime. V: violations. B: convergence drift.
worked_example.step2: B_known includes convergence drift (B_meth). Detection: switch to convergence evaluation.
worked_example.step3: Detectable from interpretability regime (mechanistic probes of internal representations).

framework_level: Measurement system demonstrated with B = empty (no blind spots across boundaries)
Six-domain convergence shown to arise from shared methodological artefact
protocol_level: Protocol fails to detect planted blind spots in controlled setting
Alpha fails to discriminate between known-different regimes
conjecture_level: General method reliably distinguishes S0/S1 from output alone

limitations: CDVC: indicator, not proof (shared cognitive bias possible)
Provenance: regime concept from thermodynamic cosmology
Evidential asymmetry: some cases well-sourced, others conceptual

implications.scientific_methodology: No single methodology can claim observational completeness
implications.ai_governance: Alignment evaluation should include convergence monitoring alongside deviation monitoring
